title: validate_session_urls prevents SSRF via malicious server session
description: fetch_session calls validate_session_urls before returning, rejecting non-http/https scheme URLs (file://, ftp://, data:, etc.). This is defense-in-depth: without it, a MITM or malicious server could inject a file:// URL into download_url and cause the client to exfiltrate local files on the first blob download. The require_http_url per-method check is secondary protection. Keep both.
